versions.changelog: Stabilize project-scoped env loading and improve the article illustration workflow.

Cyberpunk Image Generator 1.0.0

- Initial public release of the Cyberpunk Image Generator skill.
- Generates futuristic art in strict cyberpunk style based on user prompts.
- Enforces always-on cinematic style and blends key cyberpunk visual keywords into outputs.
- Integrates with the WeryAI gateway and auto-checks for local readiness and API key before first use.
- Handles both text-to-image and image-to-image operations using public URLs.
- Sets up Nano Banana 2 (GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_IMAGE) as the default model if none specified; informs users and supports seamless model switching.
